questions.question: What is the Rhodamine test? How is it used in dye examination?
questions.solution_html:
• Rhodamine test detects synthetic dyes. The dye extracts give fluorescent pink
  • coloration under UV when treated with rhodamine B reagent — used to compare
  • textile or fibre dyes. (Principle – 1, Procedure – 2, Forensic use – 1)
  • 25900405

questions.question: Describe how solid-phase extraction can be applied for drug evidence purification.
questions.solution_html:
• In SPE, the analyte is retained on a solid adsorbent column; impurities are washed
  • off, and analyte is eluted. Used for drug purification before GC/MS or HPLC
  • analysis. (Mark distribution- Principle – 1, Procedure/steps – 2, Forensic use – 1)
